entries.reachability_signal: gcov shows coverage on src/job.c get_job_options() new line 389-390 (the noclose STRCMP check)

input_strategy.details: The test file src/testdir/test_terminal.vim contains Test_terminal_finish_open_close() which now includes a noclose test case. It calls term_start() with {'term_finish': 'noclose', 'hidden': v:true} and asserts the buffer stays hidden, listed, and loaded after job completion.

before.description: Baseline (before patch): term_finish='noclose' rejected with E475 error
before.expected: Test_terminal_finish_open_close passes for open/close cases; noclose case NOT present in before version

after.description: Patched (after patch): term_finish='noclose' accepted, buffer stays hidden
after.expected: All assertions pass including noclose: buffer is hidden=1, listed=1, loaded=1 after job finishes

contract_probe.comparison: Before the patch, term_finish='noclose' would be rejected (E475). After the patch, it's accepted and keeps the terminal buffer in hidden/listed/loaded state.

prerequisites: Huge feature set build with terminal support
